definitions.explanation: A rough, masculine way to say 'to eat.' More casual and direct than 食べる.

definitions.gloss: to make a living, to survive
definitions.explanation: To earn enough to live on.
For insects or animals to bite.

examples.japanese: ⟦{腹|はら}→腹：02165_hara⟧⟦{減|へ}った→減る：01985_heru⟧、⟦{何|なに}か→何か：03873_nanika⟧{食|く}おう。

examples.english: I don't even have time to eat.

examples.japanese: ⟦{俺|おれ}→俺：02185_ore⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{何|なに}も→何も：03874_nanimo⟧{食|く}ってない。
examples.english: I haven't eaten anything since morning.

examples.japanese: ⟦あいつ→あいつ：08267_aitsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧⟦{一人|ひとり}→一人：00630_hitori⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{飯|めし}→飯：03805_meshi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{食|く}って⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{一緒|いっしょ}→一緒：02848_issho⟧⟦らしい→らしい：09502_rashii⟧。
examples.english: He always eats alone, but today he seems to be with a friend.

examples.japanese: ⟦これ→これ：00963_kore⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{食|く}って⟦いける→いける：06957_ikeru⟧。
examples.english: I can make a living with this.
I make a living by drawing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{好|す}きな→好き：02355_suki⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{食|く}っていきたい。
examples.english: I want to make a living doing what I love.

examples.english: I can't make a living with just this job.

examples.japanese: ⟦{音楽|おんがく}→音楽：00661_ongaku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{食|く}っていく⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われた→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{諦|あきら}めなかった→諦める：01813_akirameru⟧。
examples.english: I was told it's hard to make a living with music, but I didn't give up.
I was bitten by a mosquito.
I almost got bitten by a dog.

examples.japanese: ⟦{虫|むし}→虫：02262_mushi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{食|く}われて、⟦{足|あし}→足：00575_ashi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かゆい→かゆい：02340_kayui⟧。
examples.english: My leg is itchy because I was bitten by a bug.
When summer comes, I often get bitten by mosquitoes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦キャンプ→キャンプ：03837_kyanpu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{時|とき}→時：02918_toki⟧、⟦ブヨ→ブヨ：noentry⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{食|く}われて⟦{大変|たいへん}→大変：00594_taihen⟧だった。
examples.english: When I camped in the mountains, I had a terrible time being bitten by black flies.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive). Pattern: X⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{食|く}う.

{食|く}う is a rougher, more masculine way to say 'eat.'

REGISTER:
- Very casual, masculine speech
- Can sound vulgar in polite situations
- Often used by men, especially older generations

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{飯|めし}→飯：03805_meshi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{食|く}う (to eat a meal)
- {食|く}って⟦いく→行く：00119_iku⟧ (to make a living)
- 〜⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{食|く}われる (to be bitten by ~)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧: to eat (neutral, polite)
- {食|く}う: to eat (vulgar, masculine)
- ⟦{召|め}し{上|あ}がる→召し上がる：01310_meshiagaru⟧: to eat (honorific)
